name: Sample for Helbrim
summary: At the Crossroads, Apothecary Helbrim awaits a wolf heart from across the sea. Apothecary Zinge sends it from the Undercity to support the Forsaken's research in central Kalimdor.

sections.title: A Contagion Across the Sea
sections.body: Apothecary Zinge sends a Wolf Heart Sample from the Undercity to Apothecary Helbrim in the Barrens. The Royal Apothecary Society's experiments reach beyond the ruins of Lordaeron. After Apothecary Renferrel in Silverpine sent tainted organs, Zinge sought to extend their research across the world. Now a courier carries the sample overseas to Helbrim, an alchemist stationed in the Barrens' dry savanna.

sections.title: Helbrim's Ambition
sections.body: At the Crossroads, Apothecary Helbrim studies how Kalimdor's native beasts react to compounds from the Plaguelands. The wolf heart could show how those toxins affect local creatures. Helbrim believes that dissecting and testing it alongside them will help the Forsaken master poisons and unnatural afflictions.

faq.q: What is the package being delivered to Helbrim?
faq.answer: The package holds a Wolf Heart Sample, harvested by Apothecary Renferrel from Silverpine Forest's corrupted wolves and analyzed by Apothecary Zinge in the Undercity.

faq.q: Why does Apothecary Helbrim want a tainted wolf heart?
aliases: why does helbrim need wolf heart
faq.answer: Helbrim studies how toxins from Lordaeron affect Kalimdor's wildlife. He hopes the heart's extreme toxicity will help develop stronger concoctions and poisons for the Royal Apothecary Society.
Apothecary Helbrim is stationed at the Crossroads in the Barrens, on the upper exterior deck of the central watchtower overlooking the settlement.

faq.q: How does a traveler get from Undercity to the Crossroads?
faq.answer: Take the zeppelin from the tower outside Undercity to Orgrimmar in Durotar. Travel south through Durotar, cross the Southfury River into the Barrens, then follow the main road west to the Crossroads.

faq.q: Who are Apothecary Renferrel and Apothecary Zinge?
faq.answer: Apothecary Renferrel and Apothecary Zinge are researchers in the Royal Apothecary Society. Renferrel works from the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest, while Zinge studies in the Apothecarium in the Undercity.

faq.q: What faction does this research serve?
faq.answer: The research serves the Forsaken and the Royal Apothecary Society under Lady Sylvanas Windrunner. It advances their effort to create deadly chemical and biological weapons.

angles.text: As an Undead, you carry the Royal Apothecary Society's tainted specimens across the world, part of its far-reaching effort to secure Forsaken dominance through chemical supremacy.

As a member of the Horde, you see orcs and tauren welcome Forsaken aid in defending the Crossroads. The apothecaries' quiet study of plagued remains brings an unsettling presence to the peaceful Barrens.
